principle: A sponsor tool counts as a direct consumer if it is used by project runtime, CI, testing, demo production, or repo workflow before any PLAI adapter is queued.

candidateFeatures.label: Caregiver resource routing
candidateFeatures.description: Help a foster family describe a need and receive next-step resource categories, questions, and handoff suggestions.

candidateFeatures.label: Voice-guided intake
candidateFeatures.description: Let a caregiver speak a need and receive guided follow-up prompts or summaries.
candidateFeatures.staticPagesMode: visible entry point with typed fallback
candidateFeatures.liveServiceMode: hosted voice worker with secure token handling

candidateFeatures.label: Deployed UI smoke tests
candidateFeatures.description: Open the public UI preview and verify the landing, login, and dashboard routes work.

candidateFeatures.label: Frontend observability
candidateFeatures.description: Capture client errors and release evidence from the static UI preview.
candidateFeatures.staticPagesMode: browser SDK gated by public DSN
candidateFeatures.liveServiceMode: Sentry project with GitHub Actions release metadata

candidateFeatures.label: Demo production
candidateFeatures.description: Automate walkthrough capture for the UI and assistant story.
candidateFeatures.liveServiceMode: manual demo-video workflow with Simular Cloud, sponsor command, or Agent-S CLI

candidateFeatures.label: Repo engineering support
candidateFeatures.description: Use an agentic engineering assistant for scoped code tasks with visible repo artifacts.
candidateFeatures.liveServiceMode: repo tasks, patches, and review notes

candidateFeatures.label: Cache or retrieval memory
candidateFeatures.description: Cache resource metadata or support vector retrieval when an external service layer exists.
